# Quaternius horse

`horse.glb`: "Horse" by Quaternius, from the Ultimate Animated Animals pack, downloaded
2026-11-20 from Poly Pizza (https://poly.pizza/m/qvTrSG9pZF), listed there as
**CC0 1.0 (public domain)**; the pack page (https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html)
also states CC0. Rigged (50 joints) with 13 animation clips.

It is the base of the cyber-cob (`tools/blender/create_cyber_cob.py`): the rig and the
gentle clips are kept; the mesh is restyled and extended. No attribution is required;
we credit it anyway.

# Quaternius Universal Animation Library (Standard)

`universal_animation_library.glb`: the Godot glTF of Quaternius's Universal Animation
Library, Standard tier, downloaded 2026-11-20 from OpenGameArt
(https://opengameart.org/content/universal-animation-library; pack page
https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html). Its `License.txt` reads
**CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication)**. A mannequin on a 53-joint humanoid rig with
46 clips. It is the base of the Dancers (`tools/blender/create_dancers.py`).
